# Astro-Menu

> Astro-Menu is a QR digital menu and cloud POS platform for restaurants, cafes, hotels, food trucks, drive-thrus, and social media food businesses. Customers scan a QR code to view the menu, browse meals, and place orders directly from their phones — no app download required. Restaurants manage menus, branches, waitstaff, kitchen dashboards, analytics, and multi-language translations from one web dashboard.

## Key sections

- [Home](https://astro-menu.com/): Product overview and highlights.
- [Features](https://astro-menu.com/features): QR menus, self-order, cloud POS, waitstaff & kitchen dashboards, auto-translation, meal labels, analytics, and more.
- [Use Cases](https://astro-menu.com/use-cases): Restaurants, cafes, hotels, food trucks, drive-thrus, hospitals, and social media food businesses.
- [Pricing](https://astro-menu.com/pricing): Essential 149 AED/mo, Advanced 229 AED/mo, Premium 299 AED/mo. 14-day free trial, no credit card required. No commission on orders.
- [Docs](https://astro-menu.com/docs/welcome/introduction): Full product documentation.
- [Blog](https://astro-menu.com/blog): QR menu and food-tech insights.
- [Contact](https://astro-menu.com/contact): hello@astro-menu.com.

## Core links

- [Start free trial](https://app.astro-menu.com/register): Create an account — 14-day free trial, no credit card required.
- [Log in](https://app.astro-menu.com/login): Existing users.
- [Search](https://astro-menu.com/search): Search the site.
- [RSS](https://astro-menu.com/rss.xml): Blog RSS feed.

## Important

- Astro-Menu is a cloud, web-based application — no software installation needed.
- Customers view menus and place orders via QR code; payments are managed by the business, not Astro-Menu.
- Astro-Menu includes its own cloud POS; it does not integrate with third-party POS systems.
- Pricing is in AED (UAE).
